method.key: preloaded fresh explicit key; no per-request storage/cache dependency
method.httpx: same run_http; diagnostic client subclass records sockets+httpcore trace
method.server: instrumented subclass of actual uvicorn AutoHTTPProtocol; socket options read, never changed
method.stdlib: bounded connection pool, asyncio.to_thread; diagnostic HTTPConnection subclass sends small headers+bytes body in one send
method.stdlib_original_note: probe records actual standard-library header/body send calls; diagnostic explicitly coalesces regardless of original behavior
method.limitations: short fixed-order transport-only test; stdlib variant changes async backend/thread model AND coalescing, so not a single-variable causality proof
method.scored_metrics: zero by design, no inference SLA claim

benchmark.note: all offered requests are denominator; legacy response timing is not proof of model scoring

metric_definitions.scored_before_deadline: 2xx verdict; explicit scored deadline flag preferred, otherwise scored=true; not pending/fail_open; finite server latency <=30ms
metric_definitions.responses_within_30ms_pct: legacy timing of completed attempts, including quick errors; not scored success
metric_definitions.response_outcomes: mutually exclusive categories summing to offered_events; pending/fail_open counters overlap
